en: ...Valka, ...what you just told us.

Yes. What I have just described is the
nature of the universe, and the home
planet of Sir Ewin, Lady Welch, and
Lady Karlyn...
...the planet Daftine.
This is a bit...
I can't believe it, but...

<font color=blue>Valka</font> Both the Kingdom of Rubarika
and the Baschen Empire are nations
located upon a massive planet called
Daftine,
and the planet Daftine floats\nwithin a vast, endless sea of\nstars.
This world, Daftes, is the twin\nof Daftine. They are a binary\nplanet system.
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> ...Did Eve and the others\nknow about this?
<font color=blue>Eve</font> ...Yes.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> My apologies... it was\nnot my intention to hide this\nfrom you out of malice...

<font color=blue>Euwin</font> True, as the Captain said, if
someone had just told me this out of
the blue, I wouldn't have believed it
either...
In fact, they still don't quite\nbelieve it.

<font color=blue>Valka</font> If my memory serves me
correctly, in the homeland of
Mista... or rather, Captain
<player>,

there should be legal restrictions
imposing a maximum limit on
interference with the inhabitants of
planets that have not yet achieved
space exploration.
The same should apply to Dr.\nBelda's homeland, Levarance.
Their failure to tell the truth\nwas not born of malice...
Sir Ewin.
Or, based on your introduction,\nshould I call you Sir Laxter?
Euwin is fine. To me, my noble\nfamily name is nothing more\nthan a tool.
Then, Sir Euwin. And the ladies\nof Daftine as well.

We have the safety and time here to
process the truth. I can see that you
are injured and exhausted. For a while,
we shall stay here...
...Ugh.
Lady Welch? Is something...
...Right?
...Lady Welch... I know this is a\nshock, but...
No... NO WAYYYYY!!
Oof!?

This is insane! What is this!?
Not just Rubarika, but the
entire world of Daftine is
floating in a giant void!?
Whoa!! So Eve, Verda, and the\nCaptain all came from beyond\nthe stars!?
And Tika might have even\ncome from the future!?
What is this!? This is too much!\nI'm getting so hyped right now!
...Ugh.
...Lady Welch... this is going to\nbe a shock...
Ugh... No way! You've gotta be\nkidding me!!

Whoa, whoa, what is this?! Not
just Rubarika, but the entire
world of Daftine is floating in a
massive void?!
Holy cow!! So Eve, Verda, and\nthe Captain all came from\nbeyond the stars?!
And as for Tika, she might\nhave even come from the\nfuture?!
What is that?! What is that?!\nI'm getting so hyped right now!
Hey! You're Valka, right?!
Y-yes.
Since you know that, you must\nhave come from beyond the\nsky too, right?!
You came from space, didn't\nyou?! Or rather, is this place\nalready beyond the sky?!
B-beyond the sky? W-well,\nthat's correct...
Lady Welch... could you, uh,\nplease step back a bit?
No way! Let me see more!
Huh?!
This ship! And your weapons?!\nYour body?!
What?!
Let's see, if this part is like\nthis, and that part is like that...
Wait, stop it. Lady Welch!
And then, what happens if I try\npressing this button...
Ah, not there! Stop!
Here we go again.
I hope Valka is okay.
...Increasing alert level for\nWelch Vineyard...
However, diagnosis indicates\nthis state is normal... An error\nis imminent...
Everything I'm seeing, where I'm\nstanding, everything I'm\ntouching!
These are the things I would\nhave staked my entire life to\nget my hands on!
Tell me more, tell me\neverything, and if possible, let\nme examine your entire body!!
I―I said no! Hey! S-stop it...!!
Hmph!
Ow...
Urgh... T-this is nothing... L-let\nme examine...
Give it up!!
What was that all about?
Welch, wait a moment. I'll let\nyou ask all your questions\ntogether later.
Right now, there are more\nimportant things I want to ask,\nso please wait.
Nooo! Hurry up!! I'm about to\nexplode from curiosity!!

Euwin, Karlyn, I'm sure you're
both confused, but this
situation is full of mysteries for
us too.
May I speak with her first?

I don't mind. I want to get the situation
sorted out, and if we let Welch do
whatever she wants, we'll never make
any progress.
...Do as you please. It's not like\nI'd understand anything even if\nI listened.
...I'm going to get some fresh\nair.
My head hurts thanks to a\ncertain someone who is as loud\nas they are tactless.
Haaah!? What's with that\nattitude!
Welch. Right now, Karlyn is the\none who is most confused by\nthis situation.
Leave her be.
Huh!? Since when was she the\nsensitive type...
She's all alone.
What?
Big sister Karlyn is all alone\nright now.
Hey, Captain. Can I go look at\nthe scenery outside for a bit\ntoo?
...Yeah! I'm off.
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> Tika! Me too...!
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> Captain! Why are you\nstopping me!
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Hold on, Captain, are you\nokay? Letting Tika go off by\nherself...
<font color=blue>Valka</font> There are no dangerous\ncreatures in the vicinity.

Lady Karlyn appears to have
been a soldier for your enemy
forces, yet she has left her
weapon behind.
Her heart rate and pulse\nshowed significant agitation in\nresponse to what I said.
The possibility of her harming\nMiss Tika is extremely low.
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> But...

<font color=blue>Valka</font> AI Rekoro. I judge that
Miss Tika is attempting to offer
comfort to Lady Karlyn in her
sudden loneliness.
This is a prime opportunity for\nMiss Tika's emotional growth.

If you are anxious about Lady
Karlyn's movements, I shall link
AI Rekoro's sensors with those
of my ship.
You may use that to monitor\nthe two of them.
Lady Eve, would that be\nacceptable to you as well?
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> ...Please do.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> If Rekoro and the Captain\nare okay with it...
<font color=blue>Valka</font> ...It is done.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Such incredible technology.\nYou're linked with the ship,\naren't you?
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Now, to the main point.\nWhat on earth are you doing\nhere on Daftes?

<font color=blue>Verda</font> Even taking into account that
you hail from some advanced planet
called "EnII," you're quick to understand
the situation on Daftine.

Between your body's sensors and the
equipment on this ship, you've been
monitoring Daftine, haven't you? For
what purpose?
<font color=blue>Valka</font> ...Let me make this clear\nfirst.

Neither I nor <font color=yellow>EnII</font> harbor any ill
will or malicious intent toward
the planets of Daftine or
Daftes.
Originally, I was supposed to\nland on the <font color=yellow>satellite Mastima</font>.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Satellite Mastima...? By\nsatellite, you mean a moon?
<font color=blue>Valka</font> Exactly. Satellite\nMastima is the moon of the\nplanet Daftine.

On Daftine, it is known as the entity
that lowers the Moonshadow Ladder,
connecting Daftes, the moon, and
Daftine at the end of the Holy War.

And unraveling the mystery of that
Moonshadow Ladder was the primary
reason I was dispatched to this sector
of space.
Shall we start by erasing\nyou?

The most superior Summoning Sigil
adapter... how pitiful. If Evelysse hadn't
appeared, you might have been the
Gate yourself.
But a fake can never hope to\nmatch the real thing.
Your devotion thus far has\nbeen appreciated. Now, you\nmay rest...
...What was I... doing this for...
Ah...
It's you...
What do you want?
I-I'm sorry... I was just a little\nworried.
Worried? You? About me? Is\nthis some kind of joke?
Eek...!
U-um...
...Tika, was it?
Y-yes... I'm Tika Blanche.
Why the sudden formality?

Well, since I've been hiding things about
space and everything until now, I
thought I should introduce myself
properly one more time...
...I'm sorry.
...Haha.
Huh?
You... you're from a good\nfamily, aren't you?
What?
I've seen girls like you\noccasionally at Baschen's\nImperial Castle.
The kind of girls who are truly\nsweet, well-educated, wealthy,\nand loved by their families...
Uh, um... you mean I look like a\nnoble from Baschen, right?
I'm just from an ordinary family.
Even though Ricardo Franz put\na 100,000 bounty on you\nunder his own name?
I'm not from this era. I came\nfrom the future of Daftine.
That's why I don't understand\nwhy General Ricardo is looking\nfor me.
...The future.
...Tika.
Yes?
To me... the "future" is\nsomething I don't really\nunderstand.
Huh?
Born into the Fox Soul...\nbecoming a soldier... fighting in\nthe Holy War...
I've left everything beyond\ntomorrow in the hands of\nothers.

Does that mean... you come
from a time far beyond
tomorrow? Do you know what
lies ahead?
Huh? Beyond tomorrow? U-um,\nI'm not like a psychic or a\nprophet or anything,
And they didn't teach me the\ndetails at school, so I don't\nreally know, so, um...
Hehe, don't panic. There's only\none thing I want to know.
I-I don't know if I know the\nanswer, but if it's something I\ncan answer, I will.
Beyond tomorrow... in the\nDaftine where you lived...
Do the people of the Fox Soul\nlive in peace?
That's...
Or... has the very word "Fox\nSoul" vanished from the world?

To guide the galaxy toward a
righteous future for the sake
of life's survival. That is the
mission of us Morphus.
My arrival in this sector was\nalso under the direction of <font color=yellow>Ex</font>,\nwho oversees EnII.
It has been about a year since\nI drifted ashore here on Daftes.
Since a year ago? All by\nyourself?
Precisely. It is by no means a\nlong period for observation.

In particular, information regarding the
Holy Site War of Daftine is not the kind
of data that can be collected in detail
while staying on Daftes.
I would very much like to\ninterview Sir Ewin and Lady\nWelch later.
Of course, of course! Ask me\nanything, anything!!
In exchange―if I may say\nso―I'd love for you to tell me\nall about yourself, hehehehe~.
Weeeelch!! Wait! I'll talk. I'll do\nthe talking!!
I know waaaaay more about\nthe reality of the Holy Site War\nthan you do.
So, stay away from her.
Whaaaaat!? Why not!!
I have a lot I want to say, but if\nyou join in, we'll never make\nany progress.
Captain, Eve, Verda. Go ahead\nwith the necessary discussion!\nI'll hold the line here!!
You meanie, Eu-boy!!
Eve: Hang in there a bit longer,\nEuwin!
He truly is an indispensable\nman for our journey...
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Ahem. Now then, sorry,
Well, you say you've been\nobserving Daftine and Daftes...
But didn't you say earlier that\nyou were landing on the\nsatellite Mastima?
<font color=blue>Valka</font> ...Indeed.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Then why are you on\nDaftes?
<font color=blue>Valka</font> ...It is a pathetic story.
...I was shot down.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Shot down!?
<font color=blue>Verda</font> How did that happen!?
<font color=blue>Valka</font> To be honest, I don't\nknow myself.
I scrutinized every piece of data left on\nthe ship, but I couldn't find any footage\nor trace of whoever shot me down.
There is no doubt, however,\nthat it was an attack by an\nadvanced planetary power.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> An attack by an invisible\nadvanced planetary power...
...Does that mean...
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Aye... it's remarkably\nsimilar to the situation the\nLevarance fleet encountered.

<font color=blue>Valka</font> Both I and the ship's AI
were using long-range sensors
to scan the civilization levels of
both planets,
which left us completely\ndefenseless against the threat\nof attack.
The Hardier Warrior of\nMorphus travels vast galactic\ndistances via cold sleep.

The fact that the ship's
sensors kept me in cold sleep
should show you just how safe
it was supposed to be.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> You were navigating\nspace alone while in cold\nsleep!?

<font color=blue>Valka</font> That is not uncommon
for a Hardier Warrior of
Morphus; cold sleep is a
frequent practice in EnII.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> I suppose things differ\nfrom place to place...
Regardless, when we arrived in\nthis sector, we didn't see\nanything of the sort...
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Attacking so many ships\nwithout ever being seen...
That's just like a ghost ship\nfrom a scary story.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> A ghost ship? What are\nyou talking about, Eve? Such a\nthing...
<font color=blue>Valka</font> Is not impossible.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> What?
<font color=blue>Valka</font> Once, there existed an\narmy of phantoms that plunged\nthe entire universe into terror.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> An army of phantoms...
<font color=blue>Valka</font> In this universe, there is\nno such thing as "common\nsense."
There is only the accumulation\nof facts as they happen in the\nmoment.
An invisible ghost starship...\nsuch a thing may very well\nexist.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Come to think of it, the\ncolony ship Tika was on...
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Rekoro did say that they\nnever saw the attackers...
It couldn't be.
Wait a second. This\nconversation is heading in a\nweird direction.
Euwin?

Checking the situation is important. But
that ghost... starship... thing probably
isn't something we need to solve right
this second.
...No, it's not like I've fully\nwrapped my head around\n"space" and all that yet.
But I know that's not the most\nimportant thing right now.

From everything we've discussed, the
only thing that's clear is that everyone
here is in a place they aren't supposed
to be because of some unforeseen
accident.

Welch, Karlyn, and I are from Daftine.
Tika is from the future. And the
Captain and the others are on the ship
that arrived here in Daftine.
Even Valka, your original\ndestination wasn't supposed to\nbe here, right?
That is correct.
Then shouldn't we first focus\non finding a way to return to\nwhere we belong?

We should figure out how to
deal with that invisible ghost
ship once we've actually
established a way to travel,
Because discussing its true\nidentity now... will just waste\ntime and make us hungry.
<font color=blue>Euwin</font>: Let's go through this\nstep by step.

Is it correct to think of the "space" you
mentioned as the sea, "planets" as
islands or continents, and the
"spaceship" as a boat?
<font color=blue>Verda</font>: Y-yes. That\nunderstanding is correct.

<font color=blue>Euwin</font>: Valka, the Captain, and the
others―and of course, Karlyn and
us―being on this island called Daftes
right now was unplanned. Isn't that
right?
<font color=blue>Valka</font>: That is correct.
<font color=blue>Euwin</font>: What we are looking for\nis not on this Daftes.
Therefore, the first thing we\nmust do is procure a boat that\ncan cross the sea.
If we are going to discuss this,\nlet's focus on that.

<font color=blue>Euwin</font>: Regarding the ghost ship,
considering Valka has been able to live
here for a year after her ship was
destroyed, it won't be landing on
Daftes.

We can't devise a
countermeasure until we reach
the stage of deciding what to
load onto the boat we prepare.
So, I want to ask. Captain,\nValka. Can you provide a boat?
<font color=blue>Verda</font>: ...Our ship is in orbit\naround Daftine.
Considering the distance from\nDaftes, it's not that far, but...
Captain, Rekoro. Has\ncommunication with Coro been\nrestored?
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> ...It is the same as the\nCaptain's. Communication with\nCoro has not been restored.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> What about a distress\nsignal? Could we send Rekoro's\ndistress signal toward Coro...?

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> My wide-area signal
transmission function depends
on the transmission capabilities
of the escape pod itself.

The communication functions installed
in this body are not designed for
distances between a planet's surface
and its orbital path or beyond.
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> So, you can't get a ship\nready.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Valka's ship, of course...

<font color=blue>Valka</font> Between being shot
down and the crash, the
damage is too severe for it to
withstand space travel.

What about the
communications? Are the
communication functions on
Valka's ship...
Damaged. Only the life support\nand observation functions are\nstill operational.
Which is why... in truth, I\ncouldn't even send out a\ndistress signal...
...I had given up.
Hm?
I was so lonely.
What?
I thought... *sniff*... that no\none... *hic*... would ever... find\nme...
I wondered if I was just going\nto have to live on this planet\nall by myself forever.
Now, hold on...
Waaaaaaah!! I was so lonely!!
Huh? What? What's happening\nall of a sudden?!
Waaaaaaaaah! Uwaaaaaah!!
What is it? What's gotten into\nher all of a sudden!
Waaaaah!
In the Baschen of my time...\nthere are people from a race\ncalled the Foxtail.
Foxtail?
I only learned that name\nrecently.
But I already knew that people\nlike that existed.
And these Foxtail...
The people of the Fox Soul...
I'm not sure if that's who they\nare.

But... in my time, Rubarika and
Baschen are... peaceful.
Everyone just lives their lives
normally.
Normally... normally, huh.
The Fox Soul are a minority\ngroup living along the coast of\nBaschen.
Their power in Symbolism is\noverwhelmingly stronger than\nthat of ordinary people...
But they didn't exactly have\nthe most blessed\ncircumstances.

We were used as decoys in
wars, or sent to the front lines
of battles from which there
was no return.
That's... horrible.
For us, that was normal.
Normal...!
But Lord Givel changed that\nenvironment for us...

Those among the Kokon with
particularly strong symbol power were
appointed as "Beast Witches"... and the
status of the Kokon people rose
instantly.

Of course, that doesn't mean
we've forgotten what was done
to us, or that we don't hold a
grudge...
But Lord Givel, he...
...Big sister Karlyn...
Huh?
Nothing. It's just been a long\ntime since someone called me\nthat.
You see, I had a younger\nsister.
...You had one?
During the Holy War... our\nvillage was burned down by\nRubarika.

Since then, I've lived for nothing but to
avenge my sister. That's why I
accepted Lord Givel's invitation without
hesitation...
To defeat Rubarika... I wanted\nto prove the power of the Fox\nSoul...
...My loyalty was sincere...
I defeated the Rubarika\nsoldiers, and Lord Givel praised\nme...
I wanted to go to my sister's\ngrave... and tell her...
What is... all this? What on\nearth happened? I don't\nunderstand...
What could have possibly\nhappened to Lord Givel...?
Sister Karlyn...
...Sorry, I lost my composure.
I-I don't mean to say, but you\nreally did lose it.
But I was truly lonely.
I-I see...
This exploration of the Daft\nbinary planet system was my\nfirst mission as a Morphus.
If you got stranded during\nthat... well, it must have been\ntough.
Yes.
Yes, she says.
...I knew immediately when the\nCaptain's ship arrived at\nDaftine.

That's why it was so
painful―being able to see you,
yet unable to communicate. I
cried so many times.
...Captain...
H-Hey! Why are you being so\nclingy with the Captain?!

I'm making sure this isn't a dream. That
this warmth, and these human genes,
aren't just an electronic dream caused
by a sensor error...

That doesn't mean you have to
cling to him like that! There are
children present, so stop doing
things that set a bad example!
...I don't want to let go.
Seems like she's got plenty of\nenergy...
You only treat me like a child\nwhen it's convenient for you.

Ah... Valka. I hate to be the one
to rain on your parade, but...
you do realize that we are
currently stranded, yes?

Of course, Dr. Belda. However,
as long as you and the others
are here, there is a course of
action we can take.
What?

There is a place nearby that
may contain the parts needed
to build a long-range
communicator.
...What did you say?
About 30 kilometers south of\nhere, there are ruins of an\nabandoned city.
An abandoned city!? Is that\ntrue!?

They are ancient cities that perished
for some reason. A civilization that held
scientific potential equal to that of
modern advanced civilizations.
I thought there were no traces\nof humanity on Daftes?

Even in Tika's time, it was said to be so
unsuitable for human survival that it
wasn't chosen as a settlement, despite
being this close...
That should be the case, but...
There are some situations that\nI simply cannot handle on my\nown, no matter how hard I try.
But... if I'm with all of you...!

<font color=blue>Verda</font> But if there are traces of where
humans once lived, I wonder why it
wasn't chosen as a destination for
migration in Tika's time.
<font color=blue>Tika</font> I don't know... Maybe it's\njust something I haven't been\ntaught at school yet.
Do you know anything, Rekoro?
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> I suspect it was not the\ntype of information registered\nwithin the life pod's AI...
However, there is one point of\nconsideration I can present.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> And what's that?

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> Daftes is not registered as
either an emergency warp destination
or an emergency evacuation site for
the life pods.

<font color=blue>Verda</font> Now that is strange. For an
evacuation site, it seems like anywhere
would do, as long as the atmosphere
and water are compatible.

<font color=blue>Valka</font> I suspect that if it were an
evacuation site, there would be no need
to go all the way to a binary star
system when there is a home planet
nearby.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> I wonder if we'll find\nsome new information once we\nreach that ruined capital...
What's with those weirdly\ncolored rocks... they're\namazing.

Whoa... what is that tree? How
does it even grow in that
shape? I wonder if I can use it
for something...
...It looks like Welch is\ncompletely back to her old self.
Hmm? I've always been full of\nenergy!
I mean, sure, I had a few things\non my mind while we were at\nKorurine.
But how can I not get excited\nwhen I'm facing a crazy world\nfull of new things like this!
Besides, I haven't even started\ninvestigating Valka's belongings\nyet!
If anything, my energy is only\ngoing to double from here!
Lady Welch, you certainly\npossess a spirit full of\ncuriosity.
Full of it!?
Tsk, tsk, tsk! I am curiosity\nitself! Curiosity is me! I am\ncuriosity!
Now, world! Show this genius,\nbeautiful girl, Welch, everything\nyour new world has to offer!!
...Well, I suppose that's better\nthan her being depressed...

And think about it, Eu! In the "Ruined
City" ahead, there might even be
"Daftes's messengers" or the "power of
the messengers"!

Right, that's true. Both the
"servants" and their "power"
are supposed to originate from
Daftes!

I mean, given how much Valca
was bawling, I'm not sure if
we'll find anyone right away,
but...

As long as we're walking
through this unknown world, we
don't have a single second to
waste being depressed!

Before we let ourselves be
confused, there are things we
must see and things we must
consider.
Welch's "optimism" truly is the\nreal deal!
You're right. I guess this is one\nthing I should learn from Welch.
Actually...
I'm more concerned about her.
Oh, no, it's not that I think\nshe's going to do something to\nus now.
It's just... unlike us, she was\nbetrayed by her own homeland,\nright?
I just hope she doesn't snap...
Euwin, are you alright?
Me?
I mean, I'm still in shock, but I\nwouldn't say I'm devastated or\nanything.
When you're traveling alone,\nlosing your composure can lead\ndirectly to death,

so I can't afford to stay
shaken. If anything, I'd rather
just accept this situation with
a bit more grace...
Oh, Tika, how are the Arms\nholding up?
I only borrowed them from\nValka's place for a bit, but I\nthink they're doing alright.
Yeah. They still creak a little,\nbut they move normally. Even\nRekoro is surprised.
Thanks, Big Sister Welch.

...To think that the repairs of
Welch Vineyard would be
effective... It is a complex
feeling.
You're such a stubborn little\nrice ball.
R-Rice ball!?
I have told you many times... I\nam RESCUE-AI-056, commonly\nknown as Rekoro!
Yeah, yeah. I get it, I get it.

I suspect that Lady Welch's talent can
no longer be contained within the
confines of Daftine. Quite frankly, it is
worthy of admiration.
Did you hear that, Rice Ball!?\nThis is how you honestly praise\na genius!
Gnuuuuuuuu!
...I wish I could just accept\neverything as smoothly as that.
Euwin...

Regardless, we can't let our
guard down. We can't forget
about the ones who attacked
us when we first arrived.

We've walked quite a distance
from Valka's ship, and the
surroundings are starting to
change.
Maybe...
Wha?!
Hey, what are you suddenly―
Get down!!
Kyaah?!
Whoa?!
An attack?!
The sensors aren't picking up\nanything...!

For people who claim to be powerful
beings from beyond the sky, you're
completely oblivious to this strange
smell, aren't you?!
Looks like we managed to take\nit down.
My apologies, Lady Karlyn. This\nsituation was brought about by\nmy own carelessness.
...Whew, that gave me a scare.
(...It still won't activate... and\nbesides...)
Huh?

Still, this thing is definitely the
same kind of monster as the
werewolf-type "Baschen's
Beast."

The other creatures are also
the same type as the Thornite
